The company trying to clone the woolly mammoth gets a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience. A biotech firm is working to edit elephant DNA toward a cold-hardy, mammoth-like animal and return it to the Arctic grasslands. Rogan takes up the ice-age dream and its discontents.

The talk covers the science of de-extinction, the gene edits involved, and the claim that such herds could protect the permafrost. Rogan asks the Jurassic question: just because we can, should we? The segment is a lively, dated snapshot of the moment when bringing back the dead stopped being only a movie plot.
